items.name: Wand of Infernal Healing
items.description: You anoint a wounded creature with devil's blood or unholy water, giving it fast healing 1. This ability cannot repair damage caused by silver weapons, good-aligned weapons, or spells or effects with the good descriptor. The target detects as an evil creature for the duration of the spell and can sense the evil of the magic, though this has no long-term effect on the target's alignment.

items.name: Muleback Cords
items.description: This strange picture of an orc wearing metal armor embedded in his skin gives you strength somehow. Mainly the strength to carry more LOOT.

items.name: Skin Chronicles
items.description:
Imagine, if you please —
Surviving the war, only to wear chains.Surviving the chains, only to wear a uniform.Surviving the uniform, only to be shoved onto a deck.Surviving the sea, only to kiss the rocks.Surviving the wreck, only to starve in the green hell.Surviving everything, all the fire and lash and storm...
Only to die shitting myself beneath the roots.
The gods are cruel.This world is piss in the mouth of devils.

items.name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
items.description:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st

Spell Description
When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds. An undead creature can apply Spell Resistance, and can attempt a Will save to take half damage.

items.name: Chelish Crown
items.description: Defacing the crown (scratching off Abrogail’s face, carving holy symbols into it) is a high crime in Cheliax, punishable by branding, imprisonment, or execution.

items.name: Pendant of the Severed Veil
items.description:
Forged in secret within the arcane enclaves of Corentyn and blessed by a masked Hierophant of Nethys, this pendant depicts a circular, twin-faced visage: one side ivory, the other obsidian, each with serene, closed eyes and knowing expressions. It symbolizes the duality of creation and destruction—knowledge and madness—that defines Nethys, god of magic.

items.name: Explorer's outfit
items.description: This set of clothes is for someone who never knows what to expect. It includes sturdy boots, leather breeches or a skirt, a belt, a shirt (perhaps with a vest or jacket), gloves, and a cloak. Rather than a leather skirt, a leather overtunic may be worn over a cloth skirt. The clothes have plenty of pockets (especially the cloak). The outfit also includes any extra accessories you might need, such as a scarf or a wide-brimmed hat.
